launch_server: launch a monolithic diffusion server with GPU worker processes and an optional HTTP server
launch_pool_disagg_server: launch a pool-based disaggregated diffusion server with separate encoder, denoiser, and decoder GPU instances
launch_disagg_server: launch a DiffusionServer head node that connects to remote encoder, denoiser, and decoder role endpoints
launch_disagg_role: launch a standalone disaggregated role instance such as encoder, denoiser, or decoder with GPU workers
dispatch_launch: route to the correct launch function based on the disagg_role argument such as monolithic, server, encoder, denoiser, or decoder
